oneOf.description: Turn tracked changes into amendment formatting (37 CFR 1.121): an insertion's text stays, underlined; a deletion's text comes back, struck through; no revision is left. A deleted paragraph mark stays (the paragraph's struck text keeps its own line); an inserted paragraph stays with its text underlined; inserted and deleted table rows stay, their text underlined or struck. Formatting, table and section property changes have no amendment form and are accepted. Moves convert as deletion (source) and insertion (destination). Where struck and underlined text meet with a word character on both sides (a replaced word, whose redline shares one surrounding space), one plain space goes between them: "~~attached~~ <u>secured</u>", as in MPEP 714 examples; none is added next to whitespace or untouched punctuation, or for a pure insertion or deletion. Existing underline and strike are kept. `all` converts every revision, `at` one revision (`revision:7`) or those in the listed body paragraphs, `author` those of one author. Settles revisions, so it writes none of its own in either change mode.
